title: db-fahrplan-mcp: Deutsche Bahn timetables as an MCP server
description:
An MCP (Model Context Protocol) server exposing live Deutsche Bahn timetable data to language-model assistants: journey planning with fare breakdown, cheapest-time-of-day search, departure and arrival boards with real-time delays and platform changes, per-train stop lists, coach sequence, and station geosearch. It queries the JSON endpoints behind bahn.de directly, requires no API key, and is tested against recorded and live responses.

Unofficial; not affiliated with Deutsche Bahn AG.
